map.像素坐标 = ⌊(指针坐标 − 画布左上角) ÷ 单格像素尺寸⌋，越界返回空。画: Pixel coordinates = ⌊(pointer coordinate − canvas top-left) ÷ cell pixel size⌋, returning empty when out of bounds. The brush writes the current color, the eraser clears, and the eyedropper reads the cell color; when mirroring is on, the horizontally mirrored cell is written simultaneously (column = grid size − 1 − original column). The paint bucket spreads with a stack-based four-neighborhood flood: skip when the target color equals the new color, replace only when the cell color equals the target color, and push the four neighbors onto the stack
